stock_etf_commission_cents.label: Online U.S. stock and ETF commission

option_contract_fee_cents.label: Online options fee per contract (before regulatory fees)

conflicts.label: Conflicts of interest the firm discloses

disciplinary_history.label: Legal or disciplinary history (Form CRS answer)

regulatory_filing.label: Relationship summary on file with regulators

criteria.label: Account types and eligibility
criteria.explanation: Which kinds of accounts a firm offers, such as individual, joint or retirement accounts, and who is allowed to open them.

criteria.label: Minimum deposit and account fees
criteria.explanation: Some firms require a starting amount or charge fees just for having an account or moving it elsewhere.

criteria.label: Trading costs
criteria.explanation: What you pay each time you buy or sell. A $0 commission can still come with other costs, such as per-contract option fees or costs built into the price.

criteria.label: Fractional shares
criteria.explanation: Buying part of a share, so you can invest a set dollar amount instead of paying for a whole share.

criteria.label: Retirement accounts
criteria.explanation: Accounts with tax benefits for retirement saving, such as Traditional and Roth IRAs.

criteria.label: Research and education
criteria.explanation: Tools and information a firm provides. Research is information, not a recommendation for you.

criteria.label: Access to a financial advisor
criteria.explanation: Whether you can get recommendations or ongoing management from a person, and what it costs. Advice usually costs more than self-directed investing.

criteria.label: Cash and margin
criteria.explanation: A cash account uses only your own money. A margin account lets you borrow from the firm, with interest and the risk of losing more than you put in.

criteria.label: Customer support
criteria.explanation: How you can reach the firm. Only published, checkable details are shown, not opinions about quality.

criteria.label: Account opening and agreements
criteria.explanation: Every firm must verify your identity and ask for a taxpayer identification number. Read the agreements before you accept them.

criteria.label: Promotions
criteria.explanation: Sign-up offers change often and come with conditions. This app does not show them or let them affect comparisons.

criteria.label: Conflicts of interest and incentives
criteria.explanation: Ways a firm earns money that can affect what it encourages you to do. This app has no referral or affiliate relationship with any firm.
